latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Enables sales rep profile classification using the Challenger model.

- Guides users through the 10-item CEB Appendix B self-diagnostic for sales reps.
- Calculates Teach, Tailor, and Take-Control subscale scores and interprets them against empirical thresholds.
- Classifies dominant and secondary sales profiles (Challenger, Hard Worker, Relationship Builder, Lone Wolf, Reactive Problem Solver).
- Generates personalized development recommendations and prioritization based on results.
- Tailors process and language based on deal complexity and assessment context.
